item.title: Those of you who are daily driving Linux, what are your other devices?
item.summary: Just wondering. I have been a long time Android user but am thinking about switching to Apple for everything except Linux on my laptop, mostly for privacy reasons (I know they aren't nearly as good as they claim but they are much better than Android from an incentives view). I have been looking into how to integrate the Apple ecosystem with Linux and there seem to be good, albeit hacky ways to do it.
